ValidationRule.description: If Status is not Distributed, distributed date, distributed department and distributed Agent should not be changed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISPICKVAL( Coupon_Status__c, "Distributed" )) && ( ISCHANGED( Coupon_Distributed_Date__c ) || ISCHANGED( Distribution_Department__c ) || ISCHANGED( Distributed_Agent__c ) || ISCHANGED( Coupon_Distributed_to_Agent_Date__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Coupon Distributed Date, Distributed Department and Distributed Agent can only be set when setting the Coupon Status to Distributed
